source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 1 (PDF 6-24), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 1 (Computer Networks) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 Devices in a computer network communicate with each other using:
(Computer network mein devices aapas mein kis cheez ke zariye baat karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Section 1.1: network ke devices cables ya wireless signals (bina taar ke signals) se baat karte hain.

book_ref.quote: These devices communicate using cables or wireless signals.

blocks.prompt:
2 Through a network, which of these can move from one device to another?
(Network ke zariye in mein se kya aik device se doosre device tak ja sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Network data, files aur resources (wasail) ko aik device se doosre device tak bhejne deta hai.

book_ref.quote: A network allows data, files, and resources to move from one device to another.

blocks.prompt:
3 According to the chapter, networks support:
(Chapter ke mutabiq networks kis cheez mein madad karte hain?)

options.text: online learning aur remote work (ghar se kaam)

blocks.explanation: 1.1 ka Tidbit: networks online learning aur remote work (ghar se kaam) mein madad karte hain; karobar bhi rozana kaam ke liye networks par chalte hain.

book_ref.quote: Networks support online learning and remote work.

blocks.prompt:
4 Banks use computer networks for:
(Banks computer networks ko kis kaam ke liye istemal karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Uses of computer network: banks networks ko online transactions (len den) aur ATMs ke liye istemal karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Banks use networks for online transactions and ATMs.

blocks.prompt:
5 In a smart home, the network is used to:
(Smart home mein network kis kaam aata hai?)

options.text: bijli ki supply ki jagah lena
baghair devices ke khud khana pakana

blocks.explanation: Smart homes bhi devices ko control karne ke liye networks istemal karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Smart homes also use networks to control devices.

blocks.prompt:
6 Network architecture includes:
(Network architecture mein kya shamil hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Network architecture network ka mukammal design hai; is mein hardware, software aur communication rules (raabte ke usool) shamil hain.

book_ref.quote: Network architecture includes hardware, software, and communication rules.

blocks.prompt:
7 Before transmission over a network, data is broken into small:
(Network par bhejne se pehle data ko kin chhote hisson mein toda jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 1.2: bhejne se pehle data chhote packets mein toda jata hai; receiving device unhein dobara jodta hai.

book_ref.quote: Data is broken into small packets before transmission.

blocks.prompt:
8 What does the receiving device do with the packets it receives?
(Receiving device mile hue packets ke saath kya karta hai?)

options.text: Unhein jod kar asal data bana deta hai.
Unhein sender ko wapas bhej deta hai.
Unhein mazeed chhote packets mein todta hai.

blocks.explanation: Receiving device packets ko jod kar asal data bana deta hai.

book_ref.quote: The receiving device reassembles the packets into the original data.

blocks.prompt:
9 What guides data packets to their correct destination?
(Data packets ko sahi manzil tak kaun pohanchata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Packets cables ya wireless signals se safar karte hain aur networking devices unhein sahi manzil (destination) tak le jate hain.

book_ref.quote: Networking devices guide packets to the correct destination.

blocks.prompt:
10 Besides helping the network work efficiently, a good network architecture:
(Network ko achhi tarah chalane ke ilawa achhi network architecture kya karti hai?)

options.text: network ko aik device tak mehdood karti hai
protocols ki zaroorat khatam karti hai
data transfer ko sust karti hai
network ko aage barhane (expansion) mein madad deti hai

blocks.explanation: Achhi architecture network ko efficient banati hai aur aage network ko barhane (expansion) mein madad deti hai.

book_ref.quote: It also supports future expansion of the network.

blocks.prompt:
11 Computer networks are classified on the basis of their:
(Computer networks ki darja bandi (classification) kis bunyad par hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 1.3: networks ko unke size aur coverage area (ilaqa jahan tak network phaila ho) ki bunyad par taqseem kiya jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Computer networks are classified based on size and coverage area.

blocks.prompt:
12 The Internet is also called a:
(Internet ko aur kya kaha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sab se aam qismein LAN, WAN aur Internet (Public WAN) hain.

book_ref.quote: The most common types are LAN, WAN, and the Internet (Public WAN).

blocks.prompt:
13 A Local Area Network (LAN) is usually owned and managed by:
(LAN aam tor par kis ki milkiyat aur intezam mein hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: LAN aam tor par aik hi organization (idara) ki milkiyat aur intezam mein hota hai.

book_ref.quote: It is usually owned and managed by a single organization.

blocks.prompt:
14 Which technologies are commonly used in LANs?
(LANs mein aam tor par kaun si technologies istemal hoti hain?)
blocks.explanation: LAN mein Ethernet aur Wi-Fi aam hain; leased lines aur satellites WAN mein istemal hote hain.

book_ref.quote: Ethernet and Wi-Fi are commonly used in LANs.

blocks.prompt:
15 A WAN connects networks using:
(WAN networks ko kis cheez se jodta hai?)
blocks.explanation: WAN bade jughrafiyai ilaqe ko cover karta hai aur leased lines, satellites ya Internet istemal karta hai.

book_ref.quote: WAN uses leased lines, satellites, or the Internet.

blocks.prompt:
16 Which statement about a WAN is correct?
(WAN ke baare mein kaun sa bayan durust hai?)

options.text: Is ki data transfer speed LAN se kam hai.
Yeh sirf aik kamra cover karta hai.
Yeh LAN se sasta lagta hai.
Yeh kabhi Internet istemal nahin karta.

blocks.explanation: WAN mein data transfer ki raftar LAN se kam hoti hai aur WAN lagana aur chalana mehenga hai.

book_ref.quote: Data transfer speed is slower than LAN.

blocks.prompt:
17 The largest example of a Wide Area Network is:
(Wide Area Network ki sab se badi misal kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Internet WAN ki sab se badi misal hai.

book_ref.quote: The Internet is the largest example of a WAN.

blocks.prompt:
18 For communication between millions of devices, the Internet uses:
(Laakhon devices ke darmiyan raabte ke liye Internet kya istemal karta hai?)

options.text: har device ke liye alag usool

blocks.explanation: Internet aik aalmi network hai jo raabte ke liye standard protocols (muqarrar usool) istemal karta hai.

book_ref.quote: It uses standard protocols for communication.

blocks.prompt:
19 DSL (Digital Subscriber Line) provides Internet through:
(DSL (Digital Subscriber Line) Internet kis ke zariye deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Tidbit: DSL telephone lines ke zariye Internet deta hai aur aik hi waqt mein call aur browsing dono ho sakti hain.

book_ref.quote: Internet through telephone lines; allows calling and browsing at the same time.

blocks.prompt:
20 A company that provides Internet access to users is called a(n):
(Woh company jo users ko Internet ki sahulat deti hai kya kehlati hai?)
blocks.explanation: ISP (Internet Service Provider) woh company hai jo users ko Internet deti hai.

book_ref.quote: Company that provides Internet access to users.

blocks.prompt:
21 Networking devices are used to connect devices in a network and to:
(Networking devices devices ko jodne ke ilawa kya karte hain?)

options.text: data ke flow (bahao) ko control karna
sara data hamesha ke liye store karna

blocks.explanation: Section 1.4: networking devices network mein devices jodte hain aur data ke bahao (flow) ko control karte hain.

book_ref.quote: These devices control the flow of data.

blocks.prompt:
22 The unique address that each Network Interface Card has is called the:
(Har Network Interface Card ka jo munfarid (unique) address hota hai woh kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har NIC ka aik unique address hota hai jise MAC address kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: Each NIC has a unique address called MAC address.

blocks.prompt:
23 Which statement about a NIC is correct?
(NIC ke baare mein kaun sa bayan durust hai?)

options.text: Yeh hamesha sirf wired hota hai.
Yeh website names ko IP addresses mein badalta hai.
Yeh wired ya wireless ho sakta hai aur aksar jadeed devices mein pehle se laga hota hai.
Is ki zaroorat sirf printers ko hoti hai.

blocks.explanation: NIC wired ya wireless ho sakta hai; aksar jadeed devices mein NIC pehle se laga hota hai.

book_ref.quote: NICs are built into most modern devices.

blocks.prompt:
24 A device that connects devices and sends data to the correct device is a:
(Woh device jo devices ko jodta hai aur data sahi device ko bhejta hai kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Switch devices ko jodta hai aur data sahi device tak bhejta hai; is se network ki raftar aur karkardagi behtar hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: A switch connects devices and sends data to the correct device.

blocks.prompt:
25 Routers send data to its destination with the help of:
(Router data ko manzil tak kis ki madad se bhejte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Routers data packets ko sahi manzil tak bhejte hain aur is ke liye IP addresses istemal karte hain.

book_ref.quote: They use IP addresses to send data.

blocks.prompt:
26 Besides directing packets, routers also improve:
(Packets ko rasta dikhane ke ilawa router kya behtar banate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Routers network ki security (hifazat) aur control behtar karte hain; ghar aur daftar ke networks inhein bohat istemal karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Routers improve network security and control.

blocks.prompt:
27 Modems are used with which kinds of connections?
(Modems kis qism ke connections ke saath istemal hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Modems cable, DSL ya fiber connections ke saath istemal hote hain aur aksar routers ke saath kaam karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Modems are used with cable, DSL, or fiber connections.

blocks.prompt:
28 What does a modem do with the incoming signals from the ISP?
(Modem ISP se aane wale signals ke saath kya karta hai?)

options.text: sab ko block kar deta hai
unhein wapas digital shakal mein badalta hai
unhein backup ke tor par rakhta hai
unhein website names mein badalta hai

blocks.explanation: Modem digital data ko bhejne ke qabil signals mein badalta hai aur aane wale signals ko wapas digital shakal mein badalta hai.

book_ref.quote: It also converts incoming signals back into digital form.

blocks.prompt:
29 A wireless access point:
(Wireless access point kya karta hai?)

options.text: wireless network ki coverage barhata hai
website names ko IP addresses mein badalta hai
network ko subnets mein taqseem karta hai
sirf badla hua data save karta hai

blocks.explanation: Wireless access point Wi-Fi deta hai aur wireless network ki coverage (pohanch) barhata hai.

book_ref.quote: It extends wireless network coverage.

blocks.prompt:
30 Wireless access points are mainly used in:
(Wireless access points zyada tar kahan istemal hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Access points badi imaraton aur campuses mein lagaye jate hain; yeh signal ki taqat aur stability behtar karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Access points are used in large buildings and campuses.

blocks.prompt:
31 The topology that shows how data flows in the network is called:
(Woh topology jo dikhati hai ke network mein data kaise behta hai kya kehlati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Topology physical ya logical ho sakti hai: physical asal connections dikhati hai, logical batati hai ke data kaise behta hai.

book_ref.quote: Logical topology shows how data flows in the network.

blocks.prompt:
32 Network topology affects the network's:
(Network topology network ki kin cheezon par asar dalti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 1.5: topology network ki performance (karkardagi) aur maintenance (dekh bhaal) par asar dalti hai.

book_ref.quote: Topology affects network performance and maintenance.

blocks.prompt:
33 In which topology are all devices connected to a single main cable?
(Kis topology mein tamam devices aik hi main cable se jude hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Bus topology mein tamam devices aik hi lagataar main cable se jude hote hain.

book_ref.quote: In bus topology, all devices are connected to a single main cable.

blocks.prompt:
34 Bus topology is best suited to:
(Bus topology kis ke liye sab se munasib hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bus topology saada aur sasti hai aur chhote networks ke liye munasib hai; bade networks ke liye achhi nahin.

book_ref.quote: Bus topology is not good for large networks.

blocks.prompt:
35 In a star topology, the whole network stops when:
(Star topology mein poora network kab ruk jata hai?)

options.text: printer ki aik cable toot jaye

blocks.explanation: Star topology mein aik device kharab ho to baqi par asar nahin hota, lekin central hub kharab ho to network ruk jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Failure of the central hub stops the network.

blocks.prompt:
36 Which topology is widely used in modern networks?
(Jadeed networks mein kaun si topology zyada istemal hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Star topology sambhalne aur barhane mein aasan hai aur aaj kal zyada istemal hoti hai; ring topology ab kam istemal hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Star topology is widely used in modern networks.

blocks.prompt:
37 In a ring topology, data:
(Ring topology mein data kaise chalta hai?)

options.text: sirf central hub se guzarta hai
ring ke gird aik hi simt mein chalta hai
aik saath kai raston par chalta hai
root se shakhon ki taraf behta hai

blocks.explanation: Ring topology mein devices daire mein jude hote hain; data aik hi simt mein chalta hai aur har device use aage bhejta hai.

book_ref.quote: Data moves in one direction around the ring.

blocks.prompt:
38 A weakness of ring topology is that:
(Ring topology ki aik kamzori kya hai?)

options.text: data ka koi muqarrar rasta nahin
aik device ki kharabi poore network ko mutasir kar sakti hai
do se zyada devices nahin jud sakte

blocks.explanation: Ring mein har device data aage bhejta hai, is liye aik device kharab ho to poora network mutasir ho sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: Failure of one device can affect the whole network.

blocks.prompt:
39 In which topology does the failure of one link NOT stop communication because multiple paths exist?
(Kis topology mein kai raste hone ki wajah se aik link toot jane se raabta nahin rukta?)
blocks.explanation: Mesh topology mein kai raste hote hain, is liye aik link toot jaye to raabta nahin rukta.

book_ref.quote: Failure of one link does not stop communication.

blocks.prompt:
40 The main drawback of mesh topology is that it is:
(Mesh topology ki sab se badi kharabi kya hai?)

options.text: kai raste istemal nahin kar sakti
sirf do devices ke liye munasib

blocks.explanation: Mesh topology mehengi aur pecheeda hai aur bohat si cables chahiye; yeh bade aur aham networks mein istemal hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Mesh topology is expensive and complex.

blocks.prompt:
41 Tree topology combines the features of:
(Tree topology kin do topologies ki khoobiyan milati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Tree topology bus aur star ko milati hai: kai star networks aik central backbone se jude hote hain.

book_ref.quote: It combines features of both bus and star topologies

blocks.prompt:
42 In tree topology, data flows from:
(Tree topology mein data kahan se kahan behta hai?)

options.text: daire mein aik device se agle tak
har device se har device tak seedha
aik cable ke sirf dono siron tak
root (main node) se branches aur sub-branches tak

blocks.explanation: Tree topology mein devices darja ba darja (hierarchy) lage hote hain; data root (main node) se branches aur sub-branches tak jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Data flows from the root (main node) to branches and sub-branches.

blocks.prompt:
43 According to Table 1.1, 'no data collision' and 'equal access for all devices' are advantages of:
(Table 1.1 ke mutabiq 'no data collision' aur 'sab devices ko barabar rasai' kis topology ke fawaid hain?)
blocks.explanation: Table 1.1: ring topology - data munazzam tareeqe se behta hai, data ka takrao nahin hota, sab devices ko barabar rasai.

book_ref.quote: • Data flows in an organized manner • No data collision • Equal access for all devices

blocks.prompt:
44 According to Table 1.1, which topology requires less cable and is cost-effective?
(Table 1.1 ke mutabiq kis topology mein kam cable lagti hai aur woh sasti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Table 1.1: bus topology lagane mein aasan, kam cable wali aur sasti hai.

book_ref.quote: • Simple and easy to install • Requires less cable • Cost-effective

blocks.prompt:
45 'Backbone failure affects whole network' is a disadvantage of:
('Backbone ki kharabi poore network ko mutasir karti hai' kis topology ki kharabi hai?)
blocks.explanation: Table 1.1: tree topology - backbone kharab ho to poora network mutasir, setup pecheeda, zyada cabling.

book_ref.quote: • Backbone failure affects whole network • Complex setup • More cabling required

blocks.prompt:
46 The choice of the right topology depends on:
(Sahi topology ka intikhab kis baat par munhasir hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har topology ke apne fawaid hain; sahi topology ka intikhab network ki zarooriyat par munhasir hai.

book_ref.quote: Choosing the right topology depends on network needs.

blocks.prompt:
47 Network models divide the communication process into:
(Network models communication ke amal ko kis mein taqseem karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Network models communication ko mukhtalif layers (tehon) mein taqseem karte hain; har layer ka apna kaam hai.

book_ref.quote: These models divide communication into different layers.

blocks.prompt:
48 Layered network models are useful because they:
(Layers wale network models kyun mufeed hain?)

options.text: cables ki zaroorat khatam karte hain
IP addresses ki zaroorat khatam karte hain
networks sambhalna aasan banate hain aur troubleshooting mein madad dete hain

blocks.explanation: Layered models networks ko samajhna aur sambhalna aasan banate hain aur masail dhoondne (troubleshooting) mein madad dete hain.

book_ref.quote: They also help in troubleshooting network problems.

blocks.prompt:
49 In a layered structure, a change made in one layer:
(Layered dhanche mein aik layer mein tabdeeli ka kya asar hota hai?)

options.text: doosri layers par asar nahin dalti
baqi sab layers badal deti hai

blocks.explanation: Network layers: har layer ki apni zimmedari hai aur aik layer ki tabdeeli doosri layers par asar nahin dalti.

book_ref.quote: Changes in one layer do not affect other layers.

blocks.prompt:
50 OSI in the OSI model stands for:
(OSI model mein OSI ka matlab kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: OSI ka matlab Open Systems Interconnection hai; yeh network communication samajhne ka standard model hai.

book_ref.quote: The OSI model stands for Open Systems Interconnection.

blocks.prompt:
51 On the sender side (Figure 1.13), data in the OSI model flows:
(Sender ki taraf (Figure 1.13) OSI model mein data kis taraf behta hai?)

options.text: Physical layer se upar Application layer tak
sirf Session layer se Transport layer tak
Application layer se neeche Physical layer tak

blocks.explanation: Figure 1.13 sender ki taraf OSI model dikhati hai: data Application layer se neeche Physical layer tak jata hai.

book_ref.quote: OSI Model on the Sender Side Showing Data Flow from the Application Layer to the Physical Layer

blocks.prompt:
52 Which OSI layer defines cables, connectors, voltage levels and data transmission rates?
(OSI ki kaun si layer cables, connectors, voltage levels aur data transmission rates tay karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Physical layer raw data ko electrical, optical ya radio signals ki shakal mein bhejti hai aur hardware ki tafseelat tay karti hai.

book_ref.quote: It defines hardware aspects such as cables, connectors, voltage levels, and data transmission rates.

blocks.prompt:
53 Framing and error detection/correction between directly connected nodes are handled by the:
(Seedhe jude nodes ke darmiyan framing aur error detection/correction kaun si layer karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Data Link layer seedhe jude nodes ke darmiyan be-ghalti transfer yaqeeni banati hai aur framing aur error detection/correction karti hai.

book_ref.quote: It handles framing, error detection/correction, and controls access to the shared transmission medium.

blocks.prompt:
54 Which OSI layer manages logical addressing (IP addresses) and finds the best path?
(OSI ki kaun si layer logical addressing (IP addresses) sambhalti aur sab se behtar rasta dhoondti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Network layer data ko source se destination tak routing karti hai, IP addresses sambhalti hai aur behtareen rasta chunti hai.

book_ref.quote: It manages logical addressing (IP addresses) and determines the best path for data delivery.

blocks.prompt:
55 Segmentation of data into smaller units and flow control are done by the:
(Data ko chhote hisson mein todna (segmentation) aur flow control kaun si layer karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Transport layer bharosemand aur tarteeb wali delivery deti hai aur error recovery, flow control aur segmentation karti hai.

book_ref.quote: It performs error recovery, flow control, and segmentation of data into smaller units.

blocks.prompt:
56 Which OSI layer establishes, maintains and terminates communication sessions between applications?
(OSI ki kaun si layer applications ke darmiyan sessions shuru, qaim aur khatam karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Session layer sessions shuru, qaim aur khatam karti hai aur rukawat ke baad checkpoints aur recovery sambhalti hai.

book_ref.quote: Establishes, maintains, and terminates communication sessions between applications.

blocks.prompt:
57 Data encryption, compression and format conversion are the job of the:
(Data encryption, compression aur format conversion kis layer ka kaam hai?)
blocks.explanation: Presentation layer data ko application layer ke samajhne ke qabil format mein badalti hai aur encryption, compression aur format conversion karti hai.

book_ref.quote: It handles data encryption, compression, and format conversion.

blocks.prompt:
58 HTTP, FTP and email services are supported by which OSI layer?
(HTTP, FTP aur email services OSI ki kis layer mein aati hain?)
blocks.explanation: Application layer seedha users aur applications ko services deti hai aur HTTP, FTP aur email ko support karti hai.

book_ref.quote: It supports protocols like HTTP, FTP, and email services for communication and data exchange.

blocks.prompt:
59 According to the Tidbit, routing and delivery in the OSI model are managed by the:
(Tidbit ke mutabiq OSI model mein routing aur delivery kaun si layers sambhalti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Tidbit: neeche wali layers physical transfer, darmiyani layers routing aur delivery, aur upar wali layers user applications sambhalti hain.

book_ref.quote: Middle layers manage routing and delivery.

blocks.prompt:
60 For devices to communicate on a network, they must:
(Network par baat karne ke liye devices ko kya karna lazmi hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 1.7: network ke tamam devices ko aik hi protocol follow karna hota hai; protocols data ka hamwar tabadla yaqeeni banate hain.

book_ref.quote: All devices in a network must follow the same protocol.

blocks.prompt:
61 In the chapter, protocols are compared to:
(Chapter mein protocols ko kis cheez se tashbeeh di gayi hai?)

options.text: sadkein jin par gaariyan chalti hain
woh zabanein jin se computers baat karte hain

blocks.explanation: Do You Know: protocols un zabanon ki tarah hain jin se computers aapas mein baat karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Protocols are like languages that computers use to talk to each other.

blocks.prompt:
62 In TCP/IP, reliable data delivery is ensured by:
(TCP/IP mein data ki bharosemand delivery kaun yaqeeni banata hai?)
blocks.explanation: TCP data ki bharosemand delivery yaqeeni banata hai; IP addressing aur routing sambhalta hai.

book_ref.quote: TCP ensures reliable data delivery.

blocks.prompt:
63 In TCP/IP, the addressing and routing of data is handled by:
(TCP/IP mein data ki addressing aur routing kaun karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: IP data ki addressing aur routing karta hai; TCP aur IP mil kar devices ke darmiyan raabta mumkin banate hain.

book_ref.quote: IP handles the addressing and routing of data.

blocks.prompt:
64 Secure websites use which protocol instead of HTTP?
(Mehfooz websites HTTP ki jagah kaun sa protocol istemal karti hain?)
blocks.explanation: HTTP data encrypt nahin karta; mehfooz websites HTTPS istemal karti hain jo HTTP ka secure version hai.

book_ref.quote: HTTPS is the secure version of HTTP.

blocks.prompt:
65 The encryption in HTTPS is provided using:
(HTTPS mein encryption kis cheez se hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: HTTPS ki encryption SSL/TLS protocols se hoti hai, is liye passwords aur payment data aasani se chori nahin hota.

book_ref.quote: This encryption is provided using SSL/TLS protocols

blocks.prompt:
66 File Transfer Protocol (FTP) is commonly used by:
(FTP aam tor par kaun istemal karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: FTP files upload aur download karne ke liye hai aur web developers ise aam istemal karte hain; yeh badi files bhi bhej sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: It is commonly used by web developers.

blocks.prompt:
67 Which statement about FTP is correct?
(FTP ke baare mein kaun sa bayan durust hai?)

options.text: Yeh names ko IP addresses mein badalta hai.
Yeh sirf chhote text messages bhej sakta hai.
Yeh sirf remote login ke liye hai.
Yeh badi files bhej sakta hai aur is ke secure versions bhi hain.

blocks.explanation: FTP badi files bhi bhej sakta hai aur FTP ke secure versions bhi maujood hain.

book_ref.quote: Secure versions of FTP are also available.

blocks.prompt:
68 The translation of website names into IP addresses is performed by:
(Website names ko IP addresses mein badalne ka kaam kaun karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: DNS website names ko IP addresses mein badalta hai; yeh kaam DNS servers karte hain, is liye users ko numbers yaad nahin rakhne parte.

book_ref.quote: DNS servers perform this translation process.

blocks.prompt:
69 In 'IP address', IP stands for:
('IP address' mein IP ka matlab kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: IP address device ko diya gaya unique number hai; IP ka matlab Internet Protocol hai.
